description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for the job so the person pays on haveitprinted.com. This does NOT take payment: the person completes payment at checkout_url. Call it after hip_quote (show them the quote first); to pay with no person, use hip_prepare_payment and hip_complete_payment (when listed) instead. Returns checkout_url; then follow payment with hip_get_checkout_status.

customer_email.description: for the receipt and tracking email

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

name: hip_create_checkout
title: Create a checkout link
